definitions.name: G0C.MEDIAN
definitions.body: 'MDV' BIND MDV SORT 'MDS' BIND MDV LENGTH 'MDN' BIND MDS MDN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MDS MDN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: Median of a numeric Vector: mean of the two middle sorted values (one value twice when the count is odd).

definitions.name: G0C.SUMS
definitions.body: 'LE' BIND LE [ 0 GET ] MAP 'LN' BIND LE [ 1 GET ] MAP 'LA' BIND LN LA GROUP 'LG' BIND LG KEYS LG VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Ledger entries [name amount] to a Record from name to its summed amount, names in first-appearance order.
